core_struggle: The marriage has become a practical arrangement of bills and children, and she feels the distance without knowing when it grew.
mirror: You share a bed and a life, and the one thing you miss is the one you don't even know how to name.

queries.hook: Sharing a bed and a life with someone who feels like a colleague, and the loneliness of not knowing when the connection left.
queries.diagnose: When a bond is lived only for what passes, the heart feels empty; meaning is missing when we forget what does not pass.
queries.steady: The bond was real, and real things can be found again; you are not alone in feeling the distance, and it is not yours to carry alone.
queries.act: Reach out to the people and the practice that hold you; seek good company, and remember you are never truly alone.
queries.story: A couple who shared a bed and a life, and one of them felt the distance grow, who found the words to name it and the courage to begin again.

bridge: The marriage you describe as colleagues is what the texts call a bond without the heart. The loneliness is real, and it is not yours to carry alone.
week_thesis: Seven days from feeling the loneliness of the distance to naming it and finding one moment that is not about children or bills.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the loneliness of the distance, named without blame.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that the bond was real, and real things can be found again.
week_beats.steady: You hold that the distance is real, and it is not yours to carry alone.
week_beats.act: You try naming the feeling to your husband, and find one moment that is not about children or bills.
week_beats.story: A couple who shared a bed and a life shows you that the distance was real and the words to name it can be found.

insight: The marriage has become a practical arrangement, and you are the only one who feels the loneliness of it. The distance is real, and it is not yours to carry alone.
